subject: Prudeo Health: tenant-scoped log retention boundary & evidence package
messages:
From: Mary Allen <m.allen@prudeo.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Prudeo Health Security <security@prudeo.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant-scoped log retention boundary and evidence request

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from the security team at Prudeo — thanks again for the product demo last week. As part of our onboarding SOC review we need to validate the tenant-scoped session/log retention policy for our account. Our compliance team is asking for:

- Confirmation of the default TTL for tenant session logs (we've seen 30 days in the docs)
- Any available exceptions/allowances for shorter retention windows per tenant (we are evaluating a 14-day retention request)
- A sample manifest showing a small set of exported log files (anonymized) and the chain-of-custody metadata
- Controls you use when a customer requests a shorter TTL (audit logging, escrow/export options, and proof of deletion)

We'd like to collect evidence for our auditor by next Friday, 2027-06-25. Can you outline what you can provide and any required next steps (SLA addendum, DocuSign, escrow deposit)?

Thanks,
Mary Allen
Sr. Security Compliance Manager
Prudeo Health

---
Attachment: request-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet of auditor questions)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Mary Allen <m.allen@prudeo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant-scoped log retention boundary and evidence request

Mary — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (Customer Success) and Ben (Security / Forensics) to assemble the package. High-level answers up front, details below:

- Default session/log TTL: 30 days for tenant session logs in hosted deployments.
- Shorter TTLs: We can support per-tenant TTLs down to 14 days in hosted accounts via a scoped config; this requires an SLA addendum and a small configuration window for the infra team (typically 1-2 business days).
- Evidence we can provide: a small anonymized export (manifest + samples), audit trail entries for deletion operations, and a signed addendum documenting the retention change.

Marissa/Ben — can you confirm the artifacts we can produce for Prudeo and whether an escrow export (AES-256 encrypted) would be required for their auditor? Also please include any template language for the SLA addendum and the expected timelines.

Next steps for Prudeo: if you confirm acceptance of the scope (14-day TTL with escrow option) we'll generate the DocuSign addendum and schedule the export of the manifest and 3 sample log files (anonymized).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Success
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mary Allen <m.allen@prudeo.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant-scoped log retention boundary and evidence request

Hi Mary — thanks for the clear checklist. Per Jordan's note, here's the evidence pack we can prepare within the requested timeframe: 

1) Policy document (redwood-ttl-policy.pdf) — exported PDF summarizing default TTLs, per-tenant override process, and auditing controls.
2) Anonymized manifest (log_sample_manifest.csv) — includes file IDs, timestamps, hash values, and source tenant tag (redacted) for three sample files.
3) Chain-of-custody audit log extract — shows when the files were created, any read/export actions, and the deletion event when TTL expires.
4) Signed retention addendum (DocuSign) — we will prepare an SLA addendum for 14-day TTL; signing triggers a config change in our deployment.

We can also offer an encrypted escrow export if the auditor needs a separately-held copy. For the auditor's proof-of-deletion requirement we provide both: the deletion audit entries and an attestation statement signed by Redwood.

Timeline:
- Draft addendum & policy excerpt by EOD Thu 2027-06-17
- Produce anonymized manifest + sample files by Mon 2027-06-21
- Provide audit log extract + attestation by Tue 2027-06-22

Please confirm if escrow export is required and whether the auditor needs the samples in a specific format (CSV, JSONL, or gzipped NDJSON).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood-ttl-policy.pdf (policy excerpt), sample-evidence-template.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mary Allen <m.allen@prudeo.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant-scoped log retention boundary and evidence request

On Wed, Jun 16, 2027 at 11:22 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Mary — thanks for the clear checklist. Per Jordan's note, here's the evidence pack we can prepare within the requested timeframe: 

Adding technical details here for the auditor and infra team. The manifest will include the following fields: file_id, created_at (ISO8601), tenant_id (pseudonymized), sha256, object_size_bytes, storage_bucket, export_command, deletion_event_id. Sample export command (for auditor reproducibility):

aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-prod-logs --key path/to/object --profile readonly-audit

For the deletion attestation we will provide the audit trail entries from our centralized logging service and a signed statement that references the deletion_event_id for each sample. If Prudeo wants escrow we will produce an encrypted tarball (AES-256) and provide SFTP details to the escrow recipient.

I'll also create a minimal manifest CSV (attached) and a small readme describing the redaction approach used.

Ben Carter
Security & Forensics Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: log_sample_manifest.csv
From: Mary Allen <m.allen@prudeo.com>

Thanks Jordan/Marissa/Ben — this looks great and aligned with what our auditor needs. Prudeo confirms:

- Acceptance of 14-day TTL for tenant session logs with the signed addendum.
- Escrow export requested (auditor requires a separate copy). Please prepare the AES-256 export and provide SFTP upload details.
- Preferred sample format: gzipped NDJSON (we'll pass to AuditCo).

Next actions:
1) Marissa — please send the DocuSign addendum to me (m.allen@prudeo.com) with the 14-day term.
2) Ben — once the manifest + samples are ready, please upload the encrypted tarball and share SFTP credentials privately.
3) Jordan — I'll confirm when AuditCo has accepted the artifacts; likely next Tue 2027-06-22.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Mary Allen

Prudeo Health
